name: Restore a signed-in customer and load their private fit profile
description: Verifies a signed-in customer sees their own profile and marketplace without exposing another account's fit data.
steps: Sign in as a customer account
expected: The customer's profile and only their saved measurements are shown, and the marketplace catalogue loads.

name: Estimate and save a reviewed body measurement profile
description: Verifies a customer can submit both scan views, review and correct estimates, save the profile and see it again.
steps: Open Body scan and upload a front and side image
Edit one measurement and save the profile
expected: An estimate with confidence and limitations is shown, the corrected value is saved, and the latest profile appears in My fit profile.

name: Get personal styling suggestions from the AI stylist
description: Verifies the stylist returns a useful response to a customer's occasion or outfit request.
steps: Enter a request for a smart-casual outfit
expected: A readable styling response appears and does not claim unverified product fit or stock.

name: Create a vendor workspace and publish a product
description: Verifies a customer can create a vendor workspace and publish a valid catalogue item while invalid listing data is rejected.
steps: Open Sell on Seerdoon and complete the vendor form
Publish a product with a name, brand and price
expected: The account becomes a vendor, the Vendor studio appears, and the new listing is added to the marketplace.

name: Review a bag and start PayPal checkout
description: Verifies a customer can review their bag and begin a PayPal approval flow without charging before approval.
steps: Add a product to the bag
Open the bag and review the total
expected: A PayPal approval page opens for the order, or a clear error is shown if PayPal is unavailable; payment is not represented as completed.
